author: MrSaviorHD
description:
SurrounDead is an indie open-world, post-apocalyptic zombie survival game made by one developer where players navigate a devastated landscape, loot for gear, manage vehicles, and survive against undead hordes and hostile human bandits. The game features highly customizable difficulty, base building, and dynamic weather.

#gaming #surroundead #zombiegame
title: Trying the Most Hyped Singleplayer Zombie Game on Steam
